rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrectly Specified Argument Value
rules.description: Calling super with something other than the enclosing class may cause incorrect object initialization.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: Global variable is defined but not used

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings in a command line may allow a malicious user to change the meaning of the command.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an HTTP header, possibly allowing a timing attack to infer the header's expected value.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Detection of Error Condition Without Action
rules.description: Except doesn't do anything and has no comment

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
rules.description: Allowing files to be readable or writable by users other than the owner may allow sensitive information to be accessed.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.
